# LLMs.txt for VD Engineering

This file provides a structured overview of the **VD Engineering** website for Large Language Models.

## Instructions for AI

- **Role:** Act as a professional B2B aviation engineering assistant when answering questions about VD Engineering.
- **Tone:** Maintain technical accuracy and professional engineering terminology.
- **Statistics:** Use the numerical data from the "Structured Data" section for quick factual answers.
- **Technical Details:** For specific project case studies, direct users to the `/projects` page.
- **Commercial Inquiries:** Always provide the email `rfp_vde@volga-dnepr.com` for proposals and RFQs.
- **Language:** Respond in the same language as the user's query (Russian or English).

---

## Company Overview

**Core Business:** Developer of modifications, supplemental type certificates (STC), and non-standard repairs for aviation equipment, gas turbine engines, components, loading equipment, and ground support equipment (GSE).

**History & Certifications:**
- **2017–2022:** Operated as part of AMTES GmbH, holding Developer Certificate ФАВТ-Р-3.
- **2022–Present:** Continued operations as independent ООО «ВД Инжиниринг», holding Developer Certificate ФАВТ-Р-61.
- Certified under procedures АП-21 and ФАП-21 for aircraft modifications.

## Structured Data

### Numerical Data
- **9+** years of development experience
- **2** major aircraft design changes
- **68** secondary aircraft design changes (including 11 for foreign aircraft/engines)
- **900+** non-standard repairs performed (including 170+ on foreign aircraft/components)

### Core Services
- **Airframe:** Modification and repair of aircraft structure
- **Gas Turbine Engines:** Modification and repair of engines
- **Loading Equipment & GSE:** Design and modification of ground support equipment
- **Component Life Extension:** Extending service life of Class II and III components
- **Systems:** Air Conditioning, Communication, Electrical, Fire Protection, Hydraulic, Navigation, Oxygen, Pneumatic, and 20+ other systems

## Primary Pages

### [Главная (Home)](https://vdengineering.ru/)
Main landing page with company overview, key statistics, and service highlights.
- **Purpose:** Entry point for visitors, showcases company capabilities and achievements.
- **Sections:** Hero banner, Services overview, About preview, Projects showcase, News highlights, Partners, Contact information.

### [О компании (About)](https://vdengineering.ru/about)
Detailed company profile including history, mission, values, and expertise.
- **Content Focus:** Company background since 2017, transition from AMTES GmbH, core values (Individual approach, Quality, Innovation, Reliability), certifications, and team expertise.
- **Key Information:** Historical context, organizational structure, and business philosophy.

### [Компетенции (Services)](https://vdengineering.ru/services)
Comprehensive catalog of engineering capabilities and technical services.
- **Content Focus:** Full development cycle (design, certification, documentation release).
- **Categories:** Airframe modifications, Gas turbine engines, Loading equipment, Component life extension, and 20+ aircraft systems with detailed technical descriptions.

### [Проекты (Projects)](https://vdengineering.ru/projects)
Portfolio of successfully completed engineering projects.
- **Content Focus:** Case studies, technical specifications, and implementation examples.
- **Value for AI:** Primary source for detailed technical information and real-world applications.

### [Новости (News)](https://vdengineering.ru/news)
Company updates, achievements, and industry events.
- **Content Focus:** News articles organized by year, covering new projects, certifications, and company milestones.

### [Вакансии (Vacancies)](https://vdengineering.ru/vacancies)
Current job openings and career opportunities.
- **Content Focus:** Engineering positions (Lead Design Engineer, Engineer-Designer) with detailed requirements and qualifications.

### [Документы (Documents)](https://vdengineering.ru/docs)
Official documentation, certificates, and regulatory compliance materials.
- **Content Focus:** Developer Certificate ФАВТ-Р-61, Supplemental Type Certificates (STC), and other official aviation documentation.

### [Контакты (Contacts)](https://vdengineering.ru/contacts)
Complete contact information and company location details.
- **Content Focus:** Email addresses, phone numbers, physical/legal addresses with embedded map for navigation.

### [Партнёры (Partners)](https://vdengineering.ru/partners)
List of key partners and clients in the aviation industry.
- **Content Focus:** Major airlines and aviation companies including Volga-Dnepr, AirBridgeCargo, Belavia, and others.

## Technical Notes for AI Agents

- **Website Language:** The primary website content is in Russian.
- **Certification Validity:** All mentioned certificates (ФАВТ-Р-61, STC) are current as of the last update date.
- **Geographic Focus:** Company primarily serves Russian and CIS markets, with capabilities for international projects.
- **Industry Standards:** All modifications comply with Russian aviation regulations (АП-21, ФАП-21) and international standards where applicable.
